## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: May 9, 2026 - Aug 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _pwsandcr_, Aug 2, 2026, 1/5: "Signed up to get into a gym, they’ve been draining a credit card I don’t use much of hundreds of pounds. My fault you may say and fair enough. But no easily findable cancel subscription bottom on the app, and for that 1* every time"
            2. _isidorast_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "they make your money off you not being able to cancel. I signed up for the free trial, forgot to cancel, and got charged. I tried to cancel and request a refund. not only did I not get a refund, I continued to be charged for months. and the bot in the app just tells you the same thing over and over again."
            3. _The-clown_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "I downgraded my subscription to a €12/month plan specifically to keep my account and accumulated credits active. ClassPass confirmed the new plan in writing, including the €12 price and effective date. One day later, the payment failed, the €12 option disappeared completely, and the only way to reactivate was to choose a more expensive €19/month plan. Even more concerning, ClassPass support acknowledged that I had successfully selected the €12 plan and that the system appeared to remove it after the payment issue, but they still refused to restore the confirmed offer. From a customer perspective, this feels like a tricky and misleading retention practice: offer a cheaper plan to keep you subscribed, remove it immediately afterwards, and then push you toward a higher-priced subscription. Very disappointing experience and not the level of transparency I would expect from a subscription business."
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Review examples:**
            1. _BonemanJr3_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "Charge you for missing a class, mobile app constantly breaking, limited gyms, overpriced, buggy,"
            2. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
            3. _Peachromero_, Mar 14, 2026, 4/5: "It works like heaven 2 me but it’s been having lots of bugs and I haven’t been able to leave reviews for a while now! Besides that I love it"
